name: Amara
bioSnippet: I build brands, defend my playlists, and have strong opinions about a good opening line.
bio: I build brands, defend my playlists, and have strong opinions about a good opening line. Tell me something I haven't heard today.
conversationClue: Good music is a very good opening line.

name: Zainab
bioSnippet: I notice spaces, small details, and people who listen.
bio: I notice spaces, small details, and people who listen. A quiet conversation can still have plenty of spark.
conversationClue: Tell me one small thing you noticed today.

name: Ifeoma
bioSnippet: Food photos for work, film debates for pleasure.
bio: Food photos for work, film debates for pleasure. I like warmth, curiosity, and people who can laugh at themselves.
conversationClue: Your comfort meal says more than your best pickup line.

name: Tomi
bioSnippet: A good outfit is deliberate.
bio: A good outfit is deliberate. So is a good conversation. I enjoy confidence, but curiosity will get you further.
conversationClue: Compliment the outfit, then give me something to reply to.

name: Tunde
bioSnippet: I make things easier to use and occasionally overthink my own messages.
bio: I make things easier to use and occasionally overthink my own messages. Good banter helps.
conversationClue: Ask me what I redesigned in my head this week.

name: Chidi
bioSnippet: Books, slow conversations, and a playlist that doesn't need defending.
bio: Books, slow conversations, and a playlist that doesn't need defending. I prefer a thoughtful question to a grand entrance.
conversationClue: What story stayed with you after it ended?

name: Seyi
bioSnippet: I listen closely, especially when somebody claims their playlist has no skips.
bio: I listen closely, especially when somebody claims their playlist has no skips. Make a case; I'm open to being convinced.
conversationClue: Name one song you would never skip.

name: Idris
bioSnippet: I work with growing things and appreciate people with their own interests.
bio: I work with growing things and appreciate people with their own interests. Tell me what you've been making time for lately.
conversationClue: What makes a busy day feel a little quieter?

name: Adaora
bio: Small stages, big feelings, and voice notes I sometimes turn into songs. I am building my first EP between rehearsals and late-night plantain runs. Tell me what song understands you a little too well. Asake and Davido usually make it onto my rehearsal playlist.
conversationClue: If your day had a soundtrack, what would the first track be?
bioSnippet: Small stages, big feelings, and voice notes I sometimes turn into songs.

name: Raymond
bio: Good manners, thoughtful plans, and a fondness for the finer details. I have built a hospitality business and learned that an easy conversation beats a crowded room. I like confidence, good humour, and people with a life of their own.
conversationClue: Tell me your idea of a well-spent evening.
bioSnippet: Good manners, thoughtful plans, and a fondness for the finer details.

name: Vivian
bio: I run an interiors business, collect beautiful ceramics, and make time for people who can make me laugh. I enjoy a little luxury and a lot of honesty. Bring your own spark; I already know what I like.
conversationClue: Confidence is attractive. What are you quietly proud of?
bioSnippet: I run an interiors business, collect beautiful ceramics, and make time for people who can make me laugh.

name: Chief Chukwudi
bio: I believe a good story deserves time and a good guest deserves attention. Between my building business, community projects, and my garden, I still find room for old highlife records. Respect matters to me; so does knowing when to laugh at yourself.
conversationClue: Every family has a storyteller. Are you yours?
bioSnippet: I believe a good story deserves time and a good guest deserves attention.

name: Hon. Femi
bio: My diary is usually too full, but I protect a little time for books, tennis, and an unhurried conversation. I enjoy people who challenge an idea without losing their sense of humour. Ask me about the speech I rewrote six times, or something much more interesting.
conversationClue: What would you improve in your neighbourhood first?
bioSnippet: My diary is usually too full, but I protect a little time for books, tennis, and an unhurried conversation.

name: Nneka
bio: I turn music into movement, rehearse until the counts feel right, and still manage to miss a step when my friends are watching. Off the studio floor, I like street food, beach walks, and people who do not take themselves too seriously. An Asake beat gets my feet moving; Wizkid gets the cooldown slot.
conversationClue: Be honest: dancer, enthusiastic head-nodder, or both?
bioSnippet: I turn music into movement, rehearse until the counts feel right, and still manage to miss a step when my friends are watching.

name: Malik
bio: I write verses, argue about great albums, and keep a notebook full of lines that may never leave the page. I am serious about my music and less serious about my terrible cooking. Good banter and honest opinions are welcome here. Olamide is a favourite when I need lyrical energy.
conversationClue: Which album has earned a permanent place in your rotation?
bioSnippet: I write verses, argue about great albums, and keep a notebook full of lines that may never leave the page.

name: Damilola
bio: My weekdays run on careful plans, but my weekends are allowed to surprise me. I work in banking, love a good mystery, and have a soft spot for thoughtful people with a mischievous streak. Tell me something that will get me out of spreadsheet mode. Wizkid is my soundtrack for leaving the office behind.
conversationClue: What is your favourite way to switch off after work?
bioSnippet: My weekdays run on careful plans, but my weekends are allowed to surprise me.

name: Dr Aisha
bio: Medicine is a big part of my day, but it is not my whole personality. I recharge with photography, books, and ambitious attempts at a new recipe. I value kindness, curiosity, and conversations where neither of us has to have every answer.
conversationClue: What have you learned recently just because you were curious?
bioSnippet: Medicine is a big part of my day, but it is not my whole personality.

name: Emeka
bio: I work in nursing, make a very respectable pot of stew, and believe rest is a plan worth keeping. On a free day you will find me with friends, a football match, or a playlist that has no intention of being quiet. Kindness and good humour go a long way with me. Davido is usually playing while I cook.
conversationClue: A free afternoon appears out of nowhere. How do you spend it?
bioSnippet: I work in nursing, make a very respectable pot of stew, and believe rest is a plan worth keeping.

name: Kunle
bio: I work on community health projects and spend my spare time cycling, finding new food spots, and following ideas down interesting rabbit holes. I like practical kindness and people who notice the world around them. There is always room for a joke in a serious day.
conversationClue: What small change would make everyday life a little better?
bioSnippet: I work on community health projects and spend my spare time cycling, finding new food spots, and following ideas down interesting rabbit holes.

name: Ranti
bio: I run a salon, love a good transformation, and have a playlist for almost every mood. I notice the little things: a thoughtful compliment, a good colour combination, a friend who shows up. Tell me a story worth pausing the music for. My salon playlist rarely goes a day without Olamide or Asake.
conversationClue: What is one change that made you feel more like yourself?
bioSnippet: I run a salon, love a good transformation, and have a playlist for almost every mood.

name: Zuri
bio: Lagos traffic will test your patience; my outfit will not. I create beauty content, love a rooftop dinner, and can turn a quiet evening into very good banter. I enjoy looking good on my own terms, but humour and consistency impress me more than a price tag. On repeat: Wizkid for a slow evening, Davido when the night needs energy.
conversationClue: A good outfit gets attention. What keeps yours?
bioSnippet: Lagos traffic will test your patience; my outfit will not.

name: Kiki
bio: I spend my working day helping teams work better together, then switch off with pottery, a long walk, or a table full of friends. I like direct communication and people who can laugh at a small mistake. A good conversation does not need a performance review. Asake usually gets the first pick on a weekend drive.
conversationClue: What is one thing you never get tired of talking about?
bioSnippet: I spend my working day helping teams work better together, then switch off with pottery, a long walk, or a table full of friends.
